question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Final verification: check all 599 customers with non-zero LTV
WITH customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date,
        SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
),
customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        p.amount,
        p.payment_date,
        cl.first_payment_date,
        cl.total_ltv
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_ltv cl ON p.customer_id = cl.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cp.customer_id,
        cp.total_ltv,
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cp.payment_date <= cp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) / cp.total_ltv as pct_7days,
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cp.payment_date <= cp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '720' HOUR THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) / cp.total_ltv as pct_30days
    FROM customer_payments cp
    GROUP BY cp.customer_id, cp.first_payment_date, cp.total_ltv
)
SELECT 
    AVG(pct_7days) as avg_pct_7days,
    AVG(pct_30days) as avg_pct_30days,
    AVG(total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_metrics

),

    SELECT 
        cp.customer_id,
        cp.total_ltv,
        SUM(cp.amount) as total_ltv_check,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cp.payment_date <= cp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_7days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cp.payment_date <= cp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '720' HOUR THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) as ltv_30days,

        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cp.payment_date <= cp.first_payment_date + INTERVAL '168' HOUR THEN cp.amount ELSE 0 END) / cp.total_ltv as pct_7days,

)
